title: md document body
description: The body of every md type (voc, unclassified, and each type an admin registers): one Markdown document stored verbatim — `name` is the document id, `markdown` the author's text. akg reads no section structure inside it; the only thing it takes from the text is its [[ ]] links (src/wikilinks.mjs). Rendered as-is to rendered/<type>/<name>.md (voc: rendered/voc/<name>/VOC.md).

markdown.description: The whole document as the author wrote it, stored and rendered byte-for-byte.
